full_judgment: 2. Plaintiff instituted Other Class Suit No. 1 of 1996 against the defendant, the Managing committee, Pirdangi S.I. Senior (Fazil) Madrasa and others. for declaration that by resolution dated 11.12.95 the Managing Committee of the Madrasa, pursuant to the order dated 12.5.1994 of the defendant No. 4, Director General, Education, Bangladesh, stopped drawing of his salary subject to filing his original certificate was illegal and also for a mandatory injunction to allow him to perform his duty as Assistant Teacher of the said Madrasa. During pendency of the suit the plaintiff filed the original certificate, Ext. 1. The trial Court dismissed the suit on the ground that filing the certificate was not sufficient proof for passing B.A. examination and that there appeared mistake in spelling in the certificate. The plaintiffs appeal to the Court of District Judge against the decree of the trial court was allowed and the suit was decreed on the finding that as the original certificate was marked exhibit Ext. 1, the trial court committed error in not accepting the same leading to filing the revisional application under section 115 C.P.C. in the High Court Division.
